lines.text: Oh. Hello. Sorry. I am Bede. Terrarium Authority. I have two calves and one broken transport.
Yes. Orphaned. Their herd was cut off at the gap. Protective Extraction. All paperwork filed.
No. No, of course not. They are... in my care. Which is different. Is it different?

choice.text: What do they need most from you?
The herd needs them back, soon. For the lichen.

lines.text: ...Water. Milk replacer. Someone to say it will be fine.
I know. I do know. Give me a few more days.
